name: A360 Insights
author: Igor Rubas / A360

sections.description:
A360 Insights is an AI traffic analytics plugin for WordPress.

See which visitors come from ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, Claude, OpenAI, search engines, referrals and campaigns — directly inside your WordPress dashboard.

If your content is being discovered through AI assistants and answer engines, A360 Insights helps you see that traffic without digging through complex external analytics reports.

No cookies. No IP tracking. No external analytics account required. Your analytics data stays inside your own WordPress database.

Use A360 Insights to understand AI referrals, search traffic, campaign traffic and content performance from one lightweight WordPress dashboard.

Features

  • Track ChatGPT traffic
  • Track Gemini traffic
  • Track Copilot traffic
  • Track Perplexity and Claude traffic
  • Track OpenAI, Codex and additional AI discovery platforms
  • See AI Traffic Share
  • See Top AI Sources
  • Filter traffic trends by AI source or referrer
  • Track Google and Bing search traffic
  • Page and post view tracking
  • Custom post type support
  • Real-time content statistics modal
  • AI source statistics modal
  • Traffic source detection
  • Referrer analytics
  • Google Business Profile and Maps referrer detection
  • Browser-side referrer repair for visits that arrive as direct
  • Scroll depth engagement events for 25%, 50%, 75% and 90%
  • Enhanced engagement events for outbound clicks, file downloads, phone clicks, email clicks and forms
  • Anonymous session tracking with engaged sessions and engagement rate
  • Landing page funnel reporting by anonymous sessions
  • Private client report links for sharing post or landing page analytics
  • Central client report link manager with optional expiration and disable controls
  • UTM campaign tracking
  • Traffic channel breakdown
  • Dashboard summary widget
  • CSV export
  • Bot filtering
  • Ignore logged-in users
  • Ignore administrators
  • Browser prefetch filtering
  • WP-CLI and cron filtering
  • Data retention controls
  • Delete all data on uninstall
  • Privacy-friendly architecture
  • No cookies
  • No IP address storage
  • No user-agent storage
  • GDPR-friendly approach

What can you track?

  • AI assistant traffic from tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity and Claude
  • Search traffic from Google, Bing and other search engines
  • Referral traffic from websites linking to your content
  • Google Business Profile and Google Maps referrers when available
  • UTM campaigns from newsletters, ads and marketing links
  • Top posts, pages and custom post types by views
  • Anonymous scroll depth engagement events
  • Anonymous click, download and form engagement events
  • Anonymous sessions, engaged sessions and engagement rate
  • Landing funnel steps from page view to scroll, CTA clicks and form submits
  • Shareable client reports for selected posts or landing pages
  • Central client report link management from the Settings screen
  • Recent visits, source details and campaign details

Ideal for

  • Content publishers
  • SEO specialists
  • Marketing agencies
  • Landing page tracking
  • Campaign measurement
  • Privacy-conscious websites
  • Lightweight analytics alternative

Privacy

A360 Insights does NOT store:

  • IP addresses
  • Cookies
  • User IDs
  • Personal identifiers
  • User-agent strings

Optional tracking data:

  • Referrer host / URL
  • UTM parameters
  • Anonymous event timestamps
  • Anonymous scroll depth events

All analytics remain inside your own WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/a360-insights/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Go to A360 Insights → Settings
  4. Choose what content should be tracked
  5. Open Posts / Pages and click the Views counter
sections.faq:
Can I track ChatGPT traffic in WordPress?

Yes. A360 Insights detects traffic from ChatGPT and other AI assistants, then shows AI traffic directly inside your WordPress dashboard.

Which AI traffic sources are supported?

A360 Insights can classify traffic from AI and discovery platforms such as ChatGPT, OpenAI, Codex, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Perplexity, Meta AI, Mistral, You.com, Poe, Phind, DeepSeek and Grok.

Is this a Google Analytics alternative?

A360 Insights is a lightweight WordPress analytics plugin focused on AI traffic, referrers, search traffic, campaigns and content performance.
It is not intended to replace every advanced Google Analytics report, but it gives website owners a simple way to see important traffic data directly inside WordPress.

Does this show AI referrals and AI Traffic Share?

Yes. The dashboard includes AI Traffic, AI Traffic Share, Top AI Sources and source-level statistics.

How do engagement events work?

Engagement events are tracked automatically on pages where A360 Insights is active:

  • Outbound clicks count clicks on links that lead to a different domain.
  • File downloads count clicks on downloadable files such as PDF, DOC, XLS, PPT, CSV, ZIP, images, audio and video files.
  • Phone clicks count clicks on tel: links.
  • Email clicks count clicks on mailto: links.
  • Form starts count the first interaction with a form field.
  • Form submits count submitted forms.
  • Scroll events count 25%, 50%, 75% and 90% scroll depth.

The percentage shown next to each engagement event compares that event count with page views for the selected period. For example, 10 phone clicks from 100 page views shows 10%.

Does this use cookies?

No. A360 Insights does not use cookies.

Does this track IP addresses?

No. IP addresses are never stored.

Is it GDPR compliant?

The plugin is designed with privacy-first principles and avoids storing personal identifiers.
Website owners remain responsible for their own legal compliance.

Can I track UTM campaigns?

Yes. UTM source, medium and campaign parameters can be tracked.

Can I export analytics?

Yes. CSV export is included.

Does it support custom post types?

Yes.

Can I exclude administrators?

Yes.

1.6.0

  • Added landing page funnel reporting based on anonymous sessions.
  • Added funnel steps for landing page views, 75%+ scroll depth, CTA/link clicks, form starts and form submits.
  • Added a Funnel tab to the post/page statistics modal.
  • Added funnel bars to public client reports.
  • Funnel reporting is calculated from existing local page view, session and engagement tables without external accounts.

  • Connected engagement events to anonymous sessions so clicks, downloads, forms and scroll events can mark sessions as engaged.
  • Added session diagnostics and retention/reset support for the new sessions table.
